"object_23: predicted receptacle_1, actually receptacle_19 — 1x, e.g. day 0 19:00". So the mixture predicted receptacle_1 (carried) but it was actually at receptacle_19. This might be from h1's morning walk (object_23 isn't in h1's moves though). Actually, looking more carefully, the prediction of receptacle_1 might come from some combination. The actual position is receptacle_19, not receptacle_13 as h5 says.

I don't see object_19 in any rest entry! Let me check again. No, object_19 is not in any rest entry. So it's one of the "objects no hypothesis covers" - seen 5x, mostly counter_k1 (5); 1 receptacle.
